## Accumulated Context

### Decisions

Decisions are logged in PROJECT.md Key Decisions table.
Recent decisions affecting current work:

- [Phase 1]: Decouple core driver from UI; build CLI first with modular crates (`crates/monkey-core` and `crates/monkey-cli`).
- [Phase 1]: Implement multi-axis device identification (`model` + `hw_rev` + `fw_ver` + `transport` + `capabilities`) to support varied OEM batches.
- [Phase 2]: Enforce compile-time and runtime `SafetyGate` opcode whitelisting to eliminate bootloader/DFU bricking risk.
- [Phase 3]: Target 10-15 FPS for LCD animations with host-regulated frame pacing to prevent USB bus saturation and keystroke lag.
- [Phase 4]: Adopt two-tier state synchronization (30Hz RAM Preview vs 500ms debounced SPI Flash Commit) to protect NOR flash endurance.
